headline: Anthropic mathematician claims Claude helped him prove the Riemann hypothesis
summary: An Anthropic mathematician, Levent Alpöge, says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, a problem that has eluded top mathematicians for decades, after six weeks of work. Outlets note the claim still needs verification. One outlet reported a competing human solution to the same problem had also emerged, a detail other outlets' reports did not mention.
